arabic text: GHABRAI HAI ZAINAB AYA HAI MADINA\nLABREZ HAI GHAM SE HAR BIBI KA SINA
english translation text: ZAINAB IS ANXIOUS, MADINA IS HERE,\nEVERY LADY’S HEART IS OVERFLOWING WITH IMMENSE GRIEF

arabic text: IK SAAL GUZARA HAI ZINDAN SITAM MEI\nDIN BAQI GUZAREGI ZAINAB ISI GHAM MEI\nMAQTAL ME HAI ASGHER ZINDAAN MEIN SAKINA
english translation text: THEY SPENT AN AGE IN THE PRISON\nNOW THE REMAINING DAYS ZAINAB (A.S.) WILL SPEND IN THIS GRIEF\nASGHER WAS LEFT IN THE BATTLEFIELD, AND SAKINA IN THE PRISON

arabic text: AY AHLE MADINA TU KHAMOSH HI REHNA\nZAINAB SE KHUDARA TU EK LAFZ NA KEHNA\nJO SAANS BACHI HAI KHODEGI HAZINA
english translation text: O PEOPLE OF MADINA, REMAIN QUIET,\nPLEASE DO NOT SAY A WORD TO ZAINAB (A.S.),\nSHE WILL LOSE HER LAST BREATHS (BECAUSE OF THIS GRIEF)

arabic text: JAB PURSA MUJHE DENGE SAB LOG WATAN KE\nKIS TARHA CHUPAWUNGI YEH NEEL RASAN KE\nEHWAAL SAFAR KA KEHDE YE KAHIN NA
english translation text: WHEN THE PEOPLE OF THE CITY (OF MADINA) GIVE ME CONDOLENCES,\nHOW WILL I HIDE THE MARKS OF THE ROPES,\nTHE STATE OF MY TRAVELS MAY REVEAL MY PAIN

arabic text: HUJRO ME JO JAWUNGI ME AWNO MUHAMAD KE\nIS DIL KO RULAENGE BACHO KE KHILONE\nDIL SHIDATE GHAM SE PHAT JAYE KAHI NA
english translation text: WHEN I WILL GO INTO THE ROOM OF AUN AND MUHAMMAD,\nTHE SITE OF THEIR BELONGINGS WILL BREAK MY HEART\nMY HEART WILL BREAK WITH THEIR GRIEF

arabic text: MAZLOOMA MUSAFIR YE KYA JEEKE KARE AB\nBIN BHAYI KE AB TO DUSHWAR HAI JINA\nSAB KUCH TO LUTA AI PARDES ME ZAINAB
english translation text: ZAINAB (A.S.) HAS LOST EVERYTHING IN A\nDISTANT LAND WHAT IS THE POINT\nOF LIVING NOW WITHOUT HER BELOVED BROTHERS

arabic text: ZAINAB KI KHAYALON ME AWAAZ YEH AAYI\nMEHMIL SE UTAR KAR JAB FIZA NE SADA DI\nDIL THAMLO BIBI LO AYA MADINA
english translation text: THERE WAS A VOICE IN ZAINAB’S (A.S.)\nHEAD, WHEN FIZZA CAME OFF THE SADDLE\nAND SAID: 'BRACE YOURSELF, MADINA IS HERE'
